notes:
Characters speaking from dark balloons finally sound like characters.

Some titles draw a balloon black — a villain laughing, a sorcerer shouting. The app decides who is speaking by looking at how bright the area around the lettering is, and by that test a black balloon looks like open artwork, so those lines have always been read in the narrator's flat voice instead of a character's.

The app now also looks at the shape of the balloon itself, and only ever uses it to rescue a line the old test got wrong. Nothing that already sounded right can change. On the pages this was measured against, every character line that used to be flattened into narration is now spoken as dialogue.

Infinite Gacha's "Ahahaha!" and "Die, die!" are the two that started this.

It costs about 11 MB of app size, and a couple of extra seconds on pages that actually have narration on them. It runs in the background, so the app stays responsive while it thinks.

Chapters you have already read will be re-read once to pick this up.
